overall: The AG found the Committee's May 25 and June 8 notices should have included street addresses but deemed the error harmless, and declined to review the clerk-approval complaint as not an OML violation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the May 25 and June 8 meeting notices were deficient because they omitted the street addresses of Ashland High School and Ashland Town Hall.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that, while the Committee should have included the street address of the meeting locations on the respective notices, any resulting error was harmless.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the clerk had no authority to 'approve' the June 8 meeting notice, as shown by the typed notation on it.
allegations.key_passage: This allegation does not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25, and we therefore do not review it.
